titulo: Android’s physical navigation buttons are back on Googlebooks, but not the way you think
cuerpo: A common misconception I've seen with Googlebooks is that the Quick Insert and Google logo keys are new. They're not, as they first debuted a couple of years ago on some Chromebooks.
